title: Custom header field not available in Mass Changes to Purchase Contracts app
author: sai52
text:
Hi Experts, 
 I’m working on an SAP S/4HANA Cloud (Public Edition) project. My client wants to update a custom field on purchase contracts in bulk using the Mass Changes to Purchase Contracts functionality. I’m not able to get the field to show up there, and I’d appreciate your guidance. 
 What I’ve done so far 
 Created a custom field in the Custom Fields app with these details: 
 Field Label: Contract Engineer 
 Identifier: YY1_ContractEngineer 
 Field Type: Text (12) 
 Business Context: Procurement: Purchasing Document (MM_PURDOC_HEADER) 
 Published the field successfully (status shows Published ). 
 In the User Interfaces tab, under CDS Views, I can see the following mass change CDS views related to contracts. Their usage is Enabled : 
 C_CNTRLPURCONTRHIERMASSUPDT (Mass Changes to Central Hierarchy Purchase Contracts) 
 C_PURCNTRLCONTITMMASSUPDT (Mass Changes to Central Contract Items) 
 C_PURCNTRLCONTRMASSUPDT (Mass Changes to Central Contracts) The two Purchase Orders views (C_PURCHASEORDERITEMMASSUPDATE and C_PURCHASEORDERMASSUPDATE) are currently disabled, which is expected since they aren’t relevant for contracts. 
 Issue 
 Even after the field was published and the CDS views were enabled, the custom field YY1_ContractEngineer is not available in the mass change app for purchase contracts. It doesn’t appear as a selectable field to update. 
 What I’ve checked / questions 
 Is the field supposed to be available for mass change only through the Central Contracts views, or is additional configuration needed (for example in the app’s field/personalization settings)? 
 Does the Business Context MM_PURDOC_HEADER support mass updates for both central contracts and local purchase contracts , or do I need a different context for contracts? 
 Are there restrictions on which custom field types or lengths can be updated through mass changes? 
 Is there any additional step required after publishing, such as a refresh of the app, a wait for the extension to be activated, or a user role/authorization adjustment? 
 Has anyone successfully enabled a custom field in the Mass Changes to Purchase Contracts app and can share the steps? 
 System details 
 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition (release: add your release, e.g. 2508) 
 App: Mass Changes to Purchase Contracts 
 Custom Fields app: field published, CDS views enabled 
 I’ve attached a screenshot of the Custom Fields app showing the User Interfaces tab with the enabled CDS views. 
 Any pointers, notes, or documentation links would be greatly appreciated. 
 Thanks in advance, 
 Sai.
